research_question: Can a completed joint BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT Bybit event-time information shock reveal a repeatable, economically large SOLUSDT or XRPUSDT residual lag after explicit cost floors?
distinct_information_unit: The retired precursor used BTC alone as leader. This study requires a jointly observed BTC+ETH state, incorporates ETH-specific price and aggressive-flow information, and estimates each follower with a prior-only multivariate leader regression. No BTC-only threshold is retuned.

markets.venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trades

source_contract.source_identity: The sixteen raw public-trade files are reused only after their stored SHA-256 values match the preregistered list. No validation or later-period member is read.

information_contract.decision: Only after complete contemporaneous leader and follower 1, 2 or 5 second windows.
information_contract.rolling_history: All scales, activity baselines and regression coefficients end strictly before shock start.
information_contract.entry_if_pnl_opens: First actual follower trade at or after decision plus 100ms; a catch-up target already crossed before that trade invalidates the entry.
information_contract.missing_data: No time compression or interpolation across a price state older than 2000ms.

prior_model.regression: Ridge solve of follower one-second return on BTC and ETH one-second returns. Ridge lambda equals 5 percent of half the trace of the prior leader covariance matrix.
prior_model.follower_expected_horizon_return: beta_btc * completed BTC horizon return + beta_eth * completed ETH horizon return

leader_state.scale: Each leader uses prior-only 900-second realized variance scaled by horizon; require at least 600 finite and 60 nonzero one-second returns.
leader_state.common_shock_score: direction * (BTC standardized horizon return + ETH standardized horizon return) / sqrt(2)
leader_state.leader_balance_ratio: min(abs(BTC z), abs(ETH z)) / max(abs(BTC z), abs(ETH z))
leader_state.flow_alignment_average: Mean of direction-aligned BTC and ETH aggressive quote-notional imbalances.
leader_state.flow_alignment_minimum: Minimum of the two direction-aligned leader imbalances.
leader_state.activity_consensus: Geometric mean of the two leader horizon quote-notional ratios to their separate prior 900-second positive-window medians.

follower_state.remaining_gap: direction * (prior-model expected follower return - completed follower return)
follower_state.underreaction_ratio: direction * completed follower return / abs(expected follower return)
follower_state.flow_alignment: direction-aligned follower aggressive quote-notional imbalance over the completed horizon

fatal_event_availability_gate.if_failed: Stop the follower before PnL; do not open frozen validation or later periods.
